description: This file defines the TouchHighlightImageButton class, a custom Android widget extending ImageButton that adds a highlight overlay for pressed and focused states using a drawable resource.

classes.name: TouchHighlightImageButton
classes.description: A custom ImageButton that overlays a highlight drawable when focused or pressed, enhancing visual feedback for user interactions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view, resetting background and padding, and setting up the highlight drawable from theme attributes.

methods.name: drawableStateChanged
methods.description: Updates the highlight drawable state to match the view's state and triggers redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the image button content and overlays the highlight drawable.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Caches the new bounds of the view when size changes.
